=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1038-1039 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The comments fetch dropped `direction=desc` (now `per_page=100`) but the jq still takes `.[0].body`, so it reads the OLDEST bot comment instead of the newest.
  WHY: A stale clarification-needed comment can trip the gate, or a fresh one is missed and the gate waits the full 30-minute timeout; this changes behavior the issue said to preserve. Severity disagreement: the reviewers' MAJOR is mapped to high.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:981-986 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The unguarded `capture(...)` in `clarify_failure_comment_run_id` raises an error when a trusted prefix-matching comment has no valid `Run:` URL, and the caller's `2>/dev/null || echo ""` returns empty for the whole list.
  WHY: A malformed matching comment before a valid failure comment silently disables fail-fast, so the gate waits for the inactivity timeout.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1053-1062 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `CLARIFY_FAILURE_CHECKED_ID` is set before the newest-run lookup is known to have succeeded, and an empty result becomes "unknown", logging "newer Clarify run unknown exists — still waiting".
  WHY: One transient lookup failure permanently disables fail-fast for that comment and the log message is misleading.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1033-1038 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Each poll now fetches 100 comments instead of 5.
  WHY: Larger payload per poll cycle on a gate that can run 30+ minutes; the call count is unchanged and no functional failure results.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1067-1075 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The timeout error appends the "(no ... found)" note before the "(cancelled Clarify run: ...)" note, which can mislead.
  WHY: An operator may chase the cancelled run instead of finding out why no fresh Clarify run was found.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:982 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The jq in `clarify_failure_comment_run_id` runs on untrusted comment bodies, and its errors are swallowed by `2>/dev/null`, so one bad comment can silently disable fail-fast.
  WHY: The gate falls back to the inactivity timeout path.
- tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_clarify_wait.py | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new test file is not wired into any CI workflow or `UNWIRED_ALLOWLIST`, so `tests/test_ci_wires_every_test_file.py:98-104` fails.
  WHY: The static-checks and lint jobs fail (run 43047930203, job 130616802421) and the regression tests never run in CI.
- PR-level (commit message #2 / PR body, head SHA aa2c151702891a8a9226b31b8e13f82fb53b12db) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: An auto-close keyword references the `ai:orchestrator-tracking` issue #2734 in commit message #2 ("though each conflict was resolved: #2734 failed"), and minimax_minimax-m3 also reports it in the PR body ("Fixes #2734"); `lint_pr_body_auto_close` fails (run 43047930203, job 130616802426).
  WHY: A squash merge would auto-close the tracking issue, and the lint job fails so the PR cannot merge. Severity disagreement: BLOCKER (minimax_minimax-m3, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite) vs MAJOR (z-ai_glm-5_3-flash); highest used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1038-1039 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `comments?per_page=5&direction=desc` became `per_page=100` without `direction`, so `.[0]` is the oldest bot comment. The call at line 1233 in the same file still passes `direction=desc`.
  WHY: A later clarification-needed comment is never evaluated and the gate waits 30 minutes; an old comment can fail the gate. Fix: restore `&direction=desc`, and make `clarify_failure_comment_run_id` pick consistently (it takes `last`).
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:982-986 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `capture` raises on no match, which aborts the jq program, and the caller discards the error.
  WHY: A prefix-matching comment without a `Run:` URL before a valid failure comment makes the helper return empty. Fix: `capture(...; "g")?` or `test(...)` before `capture`.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1053-1062 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The checked ID is recorded before the newest-run lookup is known to have succeeded, and `capture_run_id` swallows errors.
  WHY: One failed lookup disables fail-fast for that comment and logs a wrong "newer Clarify run unknown exists" message.
- TASK_GAP (.github/workflows/ci.yml, near lines 2256-2281, or UNWIRED_ALLOWLIST) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  Requirement: Add a regression test under `tests/` that runs the wait-clarify step against a fake `gh`; every test file must run in a workflow.
  Evidence of absence: no reference to test_test_and_mark_stable_clarify_wait.py in ci.yml; the static-checks `test_every_test_file_runs_in_a_workflow` fails and `lint` fails. Suggested step: `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_clarify_wait.py`.
- TASK_GAP (.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml lines 1051-1063) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  Requirement: Issue "Suggested fix" item 2: fail-fast on `AI clarification workflow failed for` or `AI clarification workflow was cancelled/timed out for` comments, "whatever its author".
  Evidence of absence: only the "failed for" prefix triggers fail-fast; the cancelled/timed-out comment is only appended to the timeout error (lines 1052, 1073-1075), locked in by tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_clarify_wait.py:168-175; the author filter is restricted. Documented deliberate narrowing.
- TASK_GAP (both wait steps in test-and-mark-stable.yml) | severity=NIT | confidence=1
  Requirement: Name the Clarify run in the timeout `::error::` of the wait-clarify and alt-model wait steps.
  Evidence of absence: implemented at lines 1064-1078 and 5332-5343 with tests. Satisfied.
- HARDENING: .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml, `clarify_failure_comment_run_id` `select(.r == $repo)` (~line 986): the repo comparison is case-sensitive. Fix: `select((.r | ascii_downcase) == ($repo | ascii_downcase))` (1 line). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
